milestones.name: ARPANET
milestones.desc: Advanced Research Projects Agency Network (US Dept of Defense). First packet-switching network. First message 'LO' (intended 'LOGIN').

milestones.name: TCP/IP Adoption
milestones.desc: ARPANET officially switched from NCP to TCP/IP on January 1, 1983 ('Flag Day' - birth of the modern Internet).

milestones.name: World Wide Web (WWW)
milestones.desc: Invented by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN (Switzerland). Also created HTML, HTTP, URL, and the first web browser 'WorldWideWeb' (later renamed Nexus).

milestones.name: Mosaic Browser
milestones.desc: First widely popular graphical web browser developed by Marc Andreessen at NCSA.

milestones.name: Internet in India
milestones.desc: Launched publicly on August 15, 1995 by Videsh Sanchar Nigam Limited (VSNL).

keyPioneers.title: Fathers of the Internet (designed TCP/IP protocols).
Father of the World Wide Web (WWW).
Father of Email (invented network email on ARPANET and chose '@' symbol in 1971).

dnsHierarchy.desc: DNS (Domain Name System) translates human-readable domain names (www.rbi.org.in) into machine IP addresses (104.18.22.1).

components.name: MUA (Mail User Agent)
components.desc: Email client software used by the user (Outlook, Thunderbird, Gmail web client).

components.name: MTA (Mail Transfer Agent)
components.desc: Server software that routes emails using SMTP (Postfix, Sendmail, Exchange).

components.name: MDA (Mail Delivery Agent)
components.desc: Delivers email into the recipient's mailbox on the destination server.
